summary: GH Research PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into an At-the-Market Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Stifel, Nicolaus & Company, Incorporated, to offer and sell up to $200 million of ordinary shares (nominal value $0.025 per share) from time to time. The sales, if any, will be made through methods permitted by law as an at-the-market offering under Rule 415(a)(4). The offering is registered under a Form F-3 registration statement. A prospectus supplement dated May 14, 2026, accompanies the filing. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation; no price per share, premium, or expected close is stated. What to watch: actual sales execution and market conditions.
